narrative: On the bookwheel. The book open on Tilney's table among tilt-staves and painted paper. His pen is in his hand. The margin of the leaf is clean. On the bookwheel. A later leaf. The same pen, still up. No stroke in the margin. The painted paper for Monday is stacked at the end of the table.

entities.name: Edmund Tilney
entities.context: Read with the pen in his hand and did not use it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Sat with the fee not yet counted.

entities.name: the lovers' play
